from.place: 09N5 proof, the reduction from a semilocal Dedekind domain to the localizations at its maximal ideals

title: Intersection and contraction for maximal localizations of a semilocal Dedekind domain
statement: Let B be a semilocal Dedekind domain (a Noetherian integrally closed domain of Krull dimension 1 [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]) with fraction field K, and let Max(B) be its finite set of maximal ideals. Inside K one has B = intersection over m in Max(B) of B_m. For each m in Max(B), the contraction to B of the maximal ideal of B_m is m; equivalently, for every b in B, b belongs to m if and only if its image in B_m belongs to the maximal ideal of B_m.

Neither clause needs semilocality or the Dedekind hypothesis.
